why: Both share the same misses: a tan leather sofa instead of mustard velvet, and a tall etagere instead of a low bookcase. B wins on cohesion, because its navy-and-red woven cushions echo the rug and throw, its warm turned-column lamp suits the boho look better than A's stark white modern lamp, and its 110 cm coffee table is better scaled to the sofa and this large room.
